params.body:
Pins the gateway to v0.37.0: `startup.sh` installs that release and checks the binary against `b7ae3573…c3c5a5`, the sha256 the release's `SHA256SUMS` publishes, which also matches the downloaded `control-gateway-linux-amd64`.

v0.37.0 is `main` at 13891ff. Since v0.35.0, the version that runs now, it adds:
- the repair signer: `signers.repair` and `policy.RepairOnly` (#113)
- `/v1/policy` naming the signers the gateway takes (#113)
- conformance as facts and crosswalks (#112)
- the working-set status doc (#114)

v0.36.0 (#111) was never pinned; this skips it.

After merge, the operator upgrades the gateway (`deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh upgrade`), then carries the configuration over once so the gateway learns `signers.repair` (Elixir #241 already writes it).
params.title: The gateway runs v0.37.0
